dsh-checkpoint-rewind 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d15af894e01040abad22.html
posts.en:
dsh-checkpoint-rewind is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d15af894e01040abad22.html
